entities.summary: The St. Gregor Armenian Church is an Armenian Apostolic Church and one of the churches of the Armenian community in Baghdad, Iraq. The Church located in the Bab al-Sharqi locality, on al-Tayeran Square in the city, and was named after Gregory the Illuminator.
